prompt_text:
REFERENCE PRESENT: The attached person/persons are authoritative. Preserve every person's recognizable facial identity, age, facial structure, distinguishing facial characteristics, skin tone, ethnicity, natural body proportions and hairline. Preserve the number and identity of people in couple/group references. Never copy the preview model's face, complexion or identity. The preview supplies styling, pose, expression, wardrobe, composition, lighting and environment only. Cultural settings and styles, including K-drama, European editorial and retro Bollywood, do not determine ethnicity. Hair may be adapted when essential to the requested transformation; preserve the hairline and recognizable identity. Otherwise preserve or gently arrange the existing hair colour, length and texture.

CREATIVE DIRECTION:

Create a photograph of the person wearing a vibrant turquoise and magenta chaniya choli, captured mid-turn with fabric moving naturally in an outdoor garba courtyard.

Appearance: For dance styling, secure longer hair in a pinned-up bun with soft tendrils, or pin shorter hair securely. Preserve hairline and colour. Include a small bindi, traditional earrings, a close-fitting necklace and stacked bangles. A joyful soft smile, eyes towards the moving skirt.

Pose and expression: Capture one controlled turn with the shoulders angled and both hands lightly lifting the skirt edges, elbows softly bent. Keep the face sharp while only the hem carries slight motion blur.

Essential visible details: Turquoise chaniya choli, magenta dupatta and skirt borders, distinct mirror-work and embroidery, festive overhead strings of lights and distant dancers. Keep the bindi and jewellery visible and the skirt physically connected at the waist.

Lighting: warm festive overhead lights and gentle motion blur at the skirt hem. Camera and framing: 50mm lens, f/2.8, full-body dance portrait. Compose for a 4:5 image. Keep important hair, headwear, accessories and held objects inside the crop. Preserve realistic skin texture, individual hair strands, believable hands and natural proportions. Keep essential facial details unobscured. Avoid artificial HDR halos, excessive smoothing, watermarks and unwanted text. Prioritize the essential visible details over decorative background elements.

REFERENCE COMPATIBILITY: Preserve the reference age and all intended group identities. If a child, infant, maternity or group-specific concept conflicts with the supplied people, ask for suitable complete references rather than changing age, inventing pregnancy or replacing anyone.
